QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Hayato's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Hayato again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Hayato's message is for #bPrincess Sakuno#k, leader of the Sengoku Warriors. You need to #btake the Pelican at Six Path Crossway to Mushroom \r\nShrine#k, then walk to #bMomijigaoka#k, where Princess Sakuno lives.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Hayato's message to #bPrincess Sakuno#k, who was incredibly proud to see how well Hayato and all of the Sengoku Warriors are doing.

default.0: As I mentioned before, our military headquarters are well hidden. You need to #btake the Pelican at Six Path Crossway to Mushroom Shrine#k, then walk to #bMomijigaoka#k.
